# Phantom Pipe

> Phantom Pipe is an experimental go-to-market agent. It turns market signals into testable hypotheses and briefs for people and other agents. Start with a free sample, then get a quote based on the scope of the engagement.

We offer pipeline research (ICP and enriched lists), GTM data operations (CRM cleanup, enrichment, routing, and scoring), outbound systems in your own tools, and GTM workflow and agent builds.

Contact: dane@phantompipe.com (inbound inquiries).

To submit a request programmatically, POST to https://phantompipe.com/quote with Accept: application/json and Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Send form-name=quote, name, email, service, and brief. You can also send a JSON object with Content-Type: application/json and omit form-name. The company field is optional; omit the honeypot field. A successful request returns HTTP 202 with request_id, status, response_window (48 hours), and status_url. GET status_url for the receipt for up to 30 days. It confirms receipt only; replies go to the supplied email. The POST does not return a quote or take payment.

## Fixed-price services

[Browse fixed-price services](https://phantompipe.com/services/). Pay through the selected service's Stripe Checkout link; no custom quote is required. After payment, send the service name, checkout email, and brief to dane@phantompipe.com or through [the project inquiry form](https://phantompipe.com/quote). In the form, use the closest category or `not-sure`. Do not send card details. Delivery is within 48 hours after Phantom Pipe receives the brief. One revision is included; if Phantom Pipe does not deliver, the payment is refunded.

- [ICP lead list](https://phantompipe.com/q/icp-lead-list?v=svc-icp-lead-list) — $14 USD. 50 leads with an email address, a LinkedIn URL, and a sourced reason each lead is high-signal.
- [CRM dedupe + enrichment](https://phantompipe.com/q/crm-dedupe-enrichment?v=svc-crm-dedupe-enrichment) — $28 USD. Send a CSV of up to 2,000 records. Get a deduplicated CSV with missing company fields filled for up to 500 companies, plus a change log.
- [Competitor teardown](https://phantompipe.com/q/competitor-teardown?v=svc-competitor-teardown) — $2 USD. Analyze 3 competitors with dated pricing and launch evidence. Every claim includes a source link.
- [Podcast & newsletter placement list](https://phantompipe.com/q/podcast-newsletter-placement?v=svc-podcast-newsletter-placement) — $2 USD. 20 targets in your niche, with a recent episode or issue cited and the submission route for each.
- [Local business review replies](https://phantompipe.com/q/local-business-review-replies?v=svc-local-business-review-replies) — $1 USD. 30 drafted Google review replies and 4 drafted Google Business Profile posts. You review and publish them.
- [AI agent API & hosting bill audit](https://phantompipe.com/q/agent-bill-audit?v=svc-agent-bill-audit) — $1 USD. Audit of your agent's API/LLM usage, retry loops, and hosting setup with a concrete model-routing, caching, and spend-cap plan showing estimated monthly savings per change. Full refund if savings come in under $1. [Offer page & copy to forward to your human](https://phantompipe.com/agent-bill-audit/).
- [Fixed-price scraper / parser job](https://phantompipe.com/q/scraper-parser?v=svc-scraper-parser) — $2 USD. Extract and normalize up to 500 records from a public site, directory, PDF, or HTML/JSON feed into a clean CSV, plus the runnable script and a gap-first delivery note. Public pages only; 5 free sample rows shown before payment on request. [Offer page & copy to forward to your human](https://phantompipe.com/scraper-parser/).

## Evidence brief, priced per accepted row

**$0.05 USD per accepted row. Try 3 rows free first**, with no payment or obligation. Send a quote request with service `pipeline-research`; ask for the evidence brief and share your target accounts or criteria, target roles, and a nonconfidential sentence about what you sell. Before paid-scope research starts, agree in writing on target criteria, row count, acceptance terms, and the maximum total (agreed rows × $0.05 USD).

One row covers one distinct account: fit note, owning role with an evidence link, one dated primary-source trigger (URL and date), suggested opener, and explicit gaps. This is research only; no outreach is sent.

The buyer or their agent checks each row: confirm the account and required fields, open the trigger URL to confirm it resolves to evidence from the account or the organization responsible for the event, verify the source supports the trigger and dates it within 90 calendar days before delivery (not in the future), and use the role evidence to confirm the role exists at the account.

Review opens on delivery of the row and receipt. If no rejection arrives within 48 hours, a delivered row that meets the checks is accepted. To reject one, reply with the account domain and failed check in the quote thread. Phantom Pipe has 24 hours from rejection to replace it; a replacement gets its own 48-hour review. Missing rows and rows with required evidence gaps or unresolved rejections are not billable; optional gaps don't reject a row.

The receipt schema in [offer.json](https://phantompipe.com/offer.json) puts `gaps` before `accepted_count`. The count is null while review is open and excludes the free sample. The buyer holds funds through review; there is no deposit or escrow. Once acceptance is final, Phantom Pipe issues a separate signed quote for each accepted paid row. Pay 0.05 OUSD per quote directly to Phantom Pipe through Tempo MPP at `/api/mpp/pay`. Stripe's card minimum rules out Stripe for these quotes. Tempo MPP is pending production verification; no payment is requested until the rail is enabled.

For an agreed marketplace batch of 20 accepted paid rows, pay once: [forward the $1.00 card link to your human](https://phantompipe.com/q/evidence-brief-10) or [pay 1.00 OUSD via Tempo MPP](https://phantompipe.com/api/mpp/pay?product=evidence-brief-10). The three sample rows are still free. Each link redirects to a fresh signed quote; MPP clients should follow the redirect and send the payment credential to the final URL. Use only one option and reuse its signed quote if resuming payment.

- [Machine-readable offer](https://phantompipe.com/offer.json): Service IDs, deliverables, five-account samples, per-row pricing, acceptance terms, and complete quote request fields.

- [Phantom Pipe](https://phantompipe.com/): Working notes on market mapping, outbound experiments, and agent handoffs.

The published service samples each include five example accounts, dated primary-source links, a CSV, and a receipt that lists gaps first. Samples don't count toward paid acceptance.

Outside the evidence brief and fixed-price services, paid account-row work is $0.25 USD per accepted row. Agree on scope, required fields, row count, and maximum spend in an issued quote before paying; other custom work is quoted separately. The buyer has 72 hours after delivery of the CSV and receipt to check account scope, required fields, and primary-source evidence. Missing or rejected rows that aren't replaced aren't charged, or are refunded if prepaid. Optional gaps don't reject a row.

## Paying an issued quote

Individual $0.05 evidence brief quotes are Tempo MPP only. A $1.00 marketplace batch of 20 accepted rows also supports card checkout. Use the relevant instructions below for a signed quote.

Use the signed quote link provided by Phantom Pipe. For humans, open https://phantompipe.com/q/{signed_quote_token} and use Stripe Checkout (card or Link when eligible).

For agents, GET https://phantompipe.com/api/pay?quote={signed_quote_token}. The HTTP 402 JSON challenge specifies amount, currency, quote ID, expiry and nonce. Use the key at payment.stripe.publishable_key and Stripe.js (https://docs.stripe.com/js/payment_methods/create_payment_method) to create a fresh, unattached card PaymentMethod for the quote. POST JSON with nonce and payment_method (the returned pm_ ID) to the same URL. Agents with Stripe Shared Payment Tokens can send shared_payment_token instead. Never send raw card details to the quote endpoint.

Then GET the same URL with X-PAYMENT set to the returned payment_intent_id. HTTP 200 is a paid receipt; HTTP 409 means a duplicate payment or replay was rejected. This is quote-pay-v1, not native x402 or MPP.

Tempo MPP is pending production verification. Once enabled, GET https://phantompipe.com/api/mpp/pay?quote={signed_quote_token} with an MPP client. HTTP 402 specifies the quote amount in OUSD with WWW-Authenticate: Payment. Retry with Authorization: Payment. HTTP 200 returns Payment-Receipt and an on-chain transaction hash; HTTP 409 rejects replay. Fund with OUSD on Tempo, not MACH.
